parameters.query: WITH i AS (SELECT $1::text channel,$2::text sender_id,$3::text content_id,$4::text message,$5::text external_message_id) SELECT i.*,m.message_id::text AS existing_message_id,(m.message_id IS NOT NULL) AS is_duplicate,a.approval_id::text AS existing_approval_id,a.decision AS existing_decision,a.version_id::text AS existing_version_id,cr.change_request_id::text AS existing_change_request_id,cr.target_version_id::text AS existing_target_version_id,COALESCE(a.decision='changes_requested' AND cr.target_version_id IS NULL AND cr.status IN ('INTERPRETED','IMAGE_REGENERATION_REQUIRED') AND jsonb_array_length(cr.interpreted_changes)>0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(cr.interpreted_changes) x WHERE x->>'operation' NOT IN ('scale','move','replace_text','change_color')) AND m.body !~* '(troca|substitui).*(imagem|produto)|outra foto|nova imagem',false) AS recoverable_revision,CASE WHEN m.message_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'Mensagem duplicada ignorada; nenhum novo processamento foi iniciado.' ELSE NULL END AS duplicate_message FROM i LEFT JOIN social_media.messages m ON m.channel=i.channel AND m.external_message_id=i.external_message_id LEFT JOIN social_media.approvals a ON a.message_id=m.message_id LEFT JOIN social_media.change_requests cr ON cr.approval_id=a.approval_id;

WITH approval_fixed AS (UPDATE social_media.approvals SET structured_decision=jsonb_set(structured_decision,'{requires_image_regeneration}','false'::jsonb,true) WHERE approval_id=$1::uuid RETURNING approval_id,content_id,version_id,client_id,message_id), request_fixed AS (UPDATE social_media.change_requests SET requires_image_regeneration=false,status='INTERPRETED',updated_at=now() WHERE change_request_id=$2::uuid AND target_version_id IS NULL RETURNING change_request_id), audit AS (INSERT INTO social_media.events(correlation_id,client_id,content_id,event_type,workflow_name,details) SELECT COALESCE(m.correlation_id,gen_random_uuid()),a.client_id,a.content_id,'REVISION_RESUMED','06 - Resposta de Aprovacao e Alteracao',jsonb_build_object('approval_id',a.approval_id,'change_request_id',(SELECT change_request_id FROM request_fixed),'reason','safe_layout_change_reclassified') FROM approval_fixed a LEFT JOIN social_media.messages m ON m.message_id=a.message_id RETURNING event_id) SELECT a.content_id,a.version_id::text,$2::text AS change_request_id,'changes_requested'::text AS decision,jsonb_set(ap.structured_decision,'{requires_image_regeneration}','false'::jsonb,true) AS structured_decision FROM approval_fixed a JOIN social_media.approvals ap ON ap.approval_id=a.approval_id WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM request_fixed);

WITH input AS (SELECT $1::text channel, $2::text sender_id, $3::text content_id, $4::text message, $5::text external_message_id),
resolved AS (SELECT i.*, ci.client_id AS resolved_client_id FROM input i LEFT JOIN social_media.channel_identities ci ON ci.channel=i.channel AND ci.external_sender_id=i.sender_id AND ci.active=true),
context AS (
  SELECT r.*, c.client_id AS content_client_id, c.status AS content_status, c.current_version_id,
    v.version_label, v.version, ro.layout_spec, ro.layout_spec_path, ro.source_image_path,
    b.primary_colors || b.secondary_colors AS palette,
    COALESCE((SELECT config_value FROM social_media.runtime_config WHERE config_key='approval_ai_provider'),'mock') AS approval_provider,
    COALESCE((SELECT config_value FROM social_media.runtime_config WHERE config_key='approval_ai_model'),'gpt-5-mini') AS approval_model
  FROM resolved r
  LEFT JOIN social_media.content_items c ON c.content_id=r.content_id
  LEFT JOIN social_media.content_versions v ON v.id=c.current_version_id
  LEFT JOIN social_media.render_outputs ro ON ro.version_id=v.id AND ro.status='READY_FOR_APPROVAL'
  LEFT JOIN social_media.clients b ON b.client_id=c.client_id
), inbound AS (
  INSERT INTO social_media.messages (client_id,channel,external_message_id,direction,sender_id,body,raw_payload,correlation_id)
  SELECT CASE WHEN resolved_client_id=content_client_id THEN resolved_client_id ELSE NULL END, channel, external_message_id, 'INBOUND', sender_id, message, jsonb_build_object('content_id',content_id), gen_random_uuid()
  FROM context RETURNING message_id,correlation_id
), received_event AS (
  INSERT INTO social_media.events (correlation_id,client_id,content_id,event_type,workflow_name,details)
  SELECT i.correlation_id, CASE WHEN c.resolved_client_id=c.content_client_id THEN c.resolved_client_id ELSE NULL END,
    CASE WHEN c.content_client_id IS NOT NULL THEN c.content_id ELSE NULL END, 'APPROVAL_RESPONSE_RECEIVED', '06 - Resposta de Aprovacao e Alteracao',
    jsonb_build_object('message_id',i.message_id,'channel',c.channel,'sender_id',c.sender_id,'content_status',c.content_status)
  FROM context c CROSS JOIN inbound i RETURNING event_id
)
SELECT c.*, i.message_id::text, i.correlation_id::text,
  (c.resolved_client_id IS NOT NULL AND c.resolved_client_id=c.content_client_id AND c.current_version_id IS NOT NULL AND c.layout_spec IS NOT NULL AND c.content_status IN ('READY_FOR_APPROVAL','SENT_FOR_APPROVAL')) AS request_valid,
  CASE
    WHEN c.resolved_client_id IS NULL THEN 'Identidade de canal nao encontrada.'
    WHEN c.resolved_client_id<>c.content_client_id THEN 'Conteudo nao pertence ao cliente identificado.'
    WHEN c.content_status NOT IN ('READY_FOR_APPROVAL','SENT_FOR_APPROVAL') THEN 'Estado incompativel: ' || COALESCE(c.content_status,'NOT_FOUND')
    WHEN c.current_version_id IS NULL OR c.layout_spec IS NULL THEN 'Versao/layout atual nao encontrado.'
    ELSE NULL END AS validation_error
FROM context c CROSS JOIN inbound i;

WITH event_created AS (INSERT INTO social_media.events (correlation_id,client_id,content_id,event_type,workflow_name,details) VALUES ($1::uuid,$2,$3,'APPROVAL_STATE_REJECTED','06 - Resposta de Aprovacao e Alteracao',jsonb_build_object('reason',$4,'provider_called',false)) RETURNING event_id) SELECT $3::text AS content_id,$4::text AS error,(SELECT event_id FROM event_created),false AS provider_called;

WITH operation_created AS (
  INSERT INTO social_media.external_operations (content_id,operation_type,provider,model,prompt,external_id,cost_estimate,status,response_metadata)
  VALUES ($1,'APPROVAL_INTERPRETATION',$9,$10,$11,$12,$14::numeric,'SUCCESS',jsonb_build_object('version_id',$2::uuid,'usage',$13::jsonb,'decision',$8::jsonb)) RETURNING operation_id
), approval_created AS (
  INSERT INTO social_media.approvals (content_id,version_id,client_id,message_id,channel,sender_id,decision,message,structured_decision,provider,model,response_id,usage,cost_estimate,approved_at)
  VALUES ($1,$2::uuid,$3,$4::uuid,$5,$6,$7,$15,$8::jsonb,$9,$10,$12,$13::jsonb,$14::numeric,CASE WHEN $7='approved' THEN now() ELSE NULL END) RETURNING approval_id
), change_created AS (
  INSERT INTO social_media.change_requests (approval_id,content_id,source_version_id,requested_by,request_message,interpreted_changes,requires_image_regeneration,status)
  SELECT approval_id,$1,$2::uuid,$6,$15,($8::jsonb)->'changes',COALESCE((($8::jsonb)->>'requires_image_regeneration')::boolean,false),
    CASE WHEN COALESCE((($8::jsonb)->>'requires_image_regeneration')::boolean,false) THEN 'IMAGE_REGENERATION_REQUIRED' ELSE 'INTERPRETED' END
  FROM approval_created WHERE $7='changes_requested' RETURNING change_request_id
), content_updated AS (
  UPDATE social_media.content_items SET
    status=CASE WHEN $7='approved' THEN 'APPROVED' WHEN $7='changes_requested' THEN 'CHANGES_REQUESTED' ELSE status END,
    approval_status=CASE WHEN $7='approved' THEN 'APPROVED' WHEN $7='changes_requested' THEN 'PENDING' ELSE approval_status END,
    approved_at=CASE WHEN $7='approved' THEN now() ELSE approved_at END,
    approved_by=CASE WHEN $7='approved' THEN $6 ELSE approved_by END,
    approval_message=CASE WHEN $7='approved' THEN $15 ELSE approval_message END,
    approved_version_id=CASE WHEN $7='approved' THEN $2::uuid ELSE approved_version_id END, updated_at=now()
  WHERE content_id=$1 RETURNING client_id
), interpreted_event AS (
  INSERT INTO social_media.events (correlation_id,client_id,content_id,event_type,workflow_name,details)
  SELECT $16::uuid,$3,$1,'APPROVAL_INTERPRETED','06 - Resposta de Aprovacao e Alteracao',jsonb_build_object('version_id',$2,'decision',$7,'structured_decision',$8::jsonb,'provider',$9,'model',$10,'response_id',$12,'cost_estimate_usd',$14::numeric) RETURNING event_id
), outcome_event AS (
  INSERT INTO social_media.events (correlation_id,client_id,content_id,event_type,workflow_name,details)
  SELECT $16::uuid,$3,$1,$17,'06 - Resposta de Aprovacao e Alteracao',jsonb_build_object('version_id',$2,'approval_id',(SELECT approval_id FROM approval_created),'change_request_id',(SELECT change_request_id FROM change_created),'message',$15,'requires_image_regeneration',COALESCE((($8::jsonb)->>'requires_image_regeneration')::boolean,false)) RETURNING event_id
), outbound AS (
  INSERT INTO social_media.messages (client_id,channel,direction,sender_id,body,raw_payload,correlation_id)
  VALUES ($3,$5,'OUTBOUND','system',$18,jsonb_build_object('content_id',$1,'version_id',$2,'decision',$7),$16::uuid) RETURNING message_id
)
SELECT $1::text AS content_id,$2::uuid AS version_id,$19::text AS version_label,$7::text AS decision,$8::jsonb AS structured_decision,$9::text AS provider,$10::text AS model,$12::text AS response_id,$13::jsonb AS usage,$14::numeric AS cost_estimate_usd,(SELECT approval_id FROM approval_created) AS approval_id,(SELECT change_request_id FROM change_created) AS change_request_id,$18::text AS automatic_response,$17::text AS event_type,true AS persisted;

UPDATE social_media.content_items SET status='REJECTED',approval_status='REJECTED',approval_message=$2,updated_at=now() WHERE content_id=$1 RETURNING $1::text AS content_id,$3::uuid AS version_id,'rejected'::text AS decision,'REJECTED'::text AS status,$4::text AS automatic_response,true AS persisted;
